ov: الفتاة العاملة (الإنجليزية: Working Girl) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1988. الفيلم من إخراج مايك نيكولز.
plotEn:
Tess McGill is a working-class woman from Staten Island who dreams of climbing the corporate ladder to an executive position. Having earned a business degree via night school, she works as a secretary at a stockbroker firm in lower Manhattan. Her boss and male co-workers treat her like a bimbo, despite benefiting from her intelligence and business instincts. After one humiliation too many from her scornful boss (he fixes her up with a rival executive, who only wants to do cocaine and have sex), Tess retaliates by posting on a VDT what she thinks of him and of what he has done. This greatly amuses Tess's colleagues, but also gets her fired.
Shortly thereafter, Tess lands another job, this time as an administrative assistant to Katharine Parker, an associate partner at the mergers-and-acquisitions firm Petty Marsh. At first, Katharine seems supportive of Tess, encouraging her to share ideas. Eventually, however, she insists that Tess's proposed purchase of a radio network by Trask Industries would not work out.
When Katharine breaks her leg skiing, she asks Tess to house-sit. At her apartment, Tess finds meeting notes which reveal Katharine's intention to pass off the Trask Industries idea as her own. Returning home, Tess finds her live-in boyfriend cheating and dumps him. At work, she uses her hospitalized boss's connections to push the Trask proposal forward. With help from her friend Cyn, Tess gives herself a makeover, borrowing from Katharine's stylish wardrobe to look more
